'''Maroon League''' was a [[wegsphere]] team that played on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Conn Doruggan]], [[Pul]], and [[Tannan]] were members of the team. They beat [[Copper League]] when Doruggan blocked a final scoring attempt.
